chunks: A guidance and good tidings for the believers,
ai.seo_question: What is the Quran described as in relation to the believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Naml underscores the Quran's dual role as both a practical roadmap for moral conduct (hudan) and a spiritual promise of divine mercy (bushra) for the faithful. It reflects the Imams' teaching that true guidance requires not just intellectual acceptance but active adherence to the divine will, distinguishing the believers from those who merely hear the message without internalizing it.
